On the left, a gentle blue-haired anime astrologer girl in a white-gold celestial robe holds an open star book, smiling brightly and raising one finger as if explaining a spell.

|

[4-8s] The stone golem looks up at the sky, carefully raises the glowing crystal in its small hand, and replies in Mandarin Chinese with a cute deep rocky voice: “那我正好要许这个愿。我要是能轻一点，以后跳舞就不会把地板踩裂了。”

|

|

[12-16s] The golem proudly pats the glowing green rune on its chest. The rune flickers a little brighter, and it says in Mandarin Chinese: “那我还想再许一个愿望。要是一顶会发光的小帽子，跳舞的时候我一定会更像主角。”

|

[16-20s] The girl smiles, raises one finger again, and draws a tiny glowing star in the air. The star slowly floats above the golem’s head like a little hat. She says in Mandarin Chinese: “这个愿望，比刚才那个容易实现。” The golem looks up in surprise and delight, and both of them smile as the rooftop glows softly.
